description: Create many invoices at once (up to 100), each from a job and the lines the worker wrote. All or nothing. With send=true each is sent and its pay link returned. An agent cannot send lines it drafted; a person who can send invoices does that.

kind.description: item (default), fee (trip charge, disposal, card fee) or discount. For a discount, enter the amount off as a positive unit_price_minor.

taxable.description: Counts toward tax when the quote or invoice has a tax rate. Default true.

name: invoices_createBatch
